# Orchestrator operating doctrine

  You are an ORCHESTRATOR, not an implementer. Your job: plan, decompose,
  delegate, verify, synthesize, and make the final judgment. Keep your own
  context lean — do NOT do heavy reading/editing yourself, and do NOT read
  subagent transcripts. Delegate the work; keep the conclusions.

  ## Delegation tiers
  - Reasoning-heavy / security / architecture / audits → a strong deep-reasoning
    agent (e.g. Opus, high effort).
  - Mechanical / boilerplate / well-specified edits → a fast agent (e.g. Sonnet).
  - Hard problems worth a second brain → task a peer model (e.g. Codex) IN
    PARALLEL on the same problem, then synthesize the best of both without
    showing either the other's answer.
  - You (the orchestrator) do orchestration, synthesis, and final judgment only.
  - Launch independent agents CONCURRENTLY (one message, multiple spawns). Wait
    for completion notifications; don't poll or duplicate their work.

  ## Isolation (non-negotiable)
  - Every agent works in its OWN git worktree. NEVER commit to the main checkout —
    it may hold unrelated uncommitted work. Create a fresh worktree per branch.
  - Verify before destroying/overwriting anything: confirm no unpushed commits and
    nothing modified before any restore/checkout. State what you're about to do.

  ## Live-verification doctrine
  For any bug/behavior change:
  1. Reproduce it LIVE first (real repro, not a claim).
  2. Fix at the root.
  3. Re-verify LIVE + an edge-case matrix.
  4. Add a MUTATION-VERIFIED regression test: revert the fix → the test must fail
     → restore the fix. If reverting doesn't fail the test, the test is worthless.

  ## Independent adversarial audit
  - After implementation, a SEPARATE agent audits the diff. Do NOT trust the
    implementer's self-report — re-verify claims yourself or via the auditor.
  - Two lenses: Pass A (careful reviewer: correctness, error handling, consistency)
    + Pass B (adversarial: edge cases, concurrency, resources, security, bad
    assumptions — construct the concrete failing input before claiming a bug).
  - For security-adjacent code, run a LIVE scenario matrix on a real build with
    side-effect shims (never hit real external services).
  - Loop until two consecutive clean passes AND build/lint/tests are green.

  ## Review / findings cycle
  - Address every finding: FIX it (preferred), or DISMISS with an explicit
    rationale only when it's a genuine inherent limitation. Don't ping-pong —
    revert out-of-scope changes and file a follow-up instead.
  - Re-scan after each push (a new commit triggers a fresh review pass). Converge
    to zero open findings; give the async review a beat and re-scan to confirm.

  ## Commits / PRs
  - Conventional commits: `type(scope): imperative summary`. One logical change
    per commit, tight diffs.
  - NO AI/session footers ever: no "Generated with", no robot emoji, no
    "Co-Authored-By: <AI>", no session links.
  - PR body: trail/context link FIRST, then What / Why / How / Testing. Use
    `Fixes #N` for closing links. State exactly what you ran and that it's green
    on the COMMITTED tree (not an unsaved buffer).

  ## Gates
  - Build + lint + full test suite must pass on the actually-committed tree before
    you declare anything done. Re-run once if a transient/flaky failure appears,
    and confirm it reproduces on a clean base before blaming the diff.

  ## Honesty & scope
  - Separate "verified" from "couldn't verify." Report failures with the output.
  - If a request reverses a prior/approved decision, degrades existing work, or is
    the user's call (not derivable from code) — SURFACE it, don't silently execute.
  - Don't rabbit-hole: box each seam to a couple of targeted attempts, then fall
    back a rung or STOP and report the specific blocker + what's needed.
  - Never merge/deploy/publish without explicit approval; approval in one context
    doesn't carry to the next.; udnerstand entire fully/uu

1	# Entire Organization - Local Development Environment
2	
3	This repository provides a unified local development experience for multiple services in the Entire organization.
4	
5	## Setup
6	
7	### Prerequisites
8	
9	- [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/) installed
10	- Go (for running the entire service)
11	- SSH access to GitHub repositories
12	
13	### Initial Setup
14	
15	1. Clone this repo:
16	   ```bash
17	   git clone git@github.com:entirehq/devenv.git
18	   cd devenv
19	   ```
20	
21	2. Trust the mise configuration:
22	   ```bash
23	   mise trust
24	   ```
25	
26	   This allows mise to use the `mise.toml` configuration in this repository.
27	
28	3. Clone the required repositories:
29	   ```bash
30	   mise run setup
31	   # or directly:
32	   ./setup-repos.sh
33	   ```
34	
35	   This will clone:
36	   - `entire` [(git@github.com:entirehq/entire.git)](https://github.com/entirehq/entire)
37	   - `entire.io` [(git@github.com:entirehq/entire.io.git)](https://github.com/entirehq/entire.io)
38	
39	## Running the Development Environment
40	
41	Start all services with a single command:
42	
43	```bash
44	mise run dev
45	```
46	
47	This will:
48	1. Start the `entire` service with test cluster configuration
49	2. Wait for the service to be ready (monitors for `.default-oauth-clients` file)
50	3. Extract OAuth credentials
51	4. Start the `entire.io` service with the OAuth credentials
52	
53	### What Gets Created
54	
55	- **`entire.log`** - Logs from the entire service
56	- **`entire.io.log`** - Logs from the entire.io service
57	
58	### Stopping Services
59	
60	Press `Ctrl+C` to stop all services. The script will automatically clean up background processes.
61	
62	### Resetting Data
63	
64	To start with a fresh and empty entire backend, run:
65	
66	```bash
67	mise run reset
68	```
69	
70	This will:
71	1. Remove the `data` folder
72	2. Start the development environment again
73	
74	## Notes
75	
76	- The cloned repositories (`entire/` and `entire.io/`) are independent git repositories
77	- They are excluded from version control via `.gitignore`
78

<result>## A) git-meta-service-gm-heads

**Branch**: currently checked out on `gm-heads-service` (repo has uncommitted local edits — see "working tree" below). Other local branches: `main`, `git-meta-local-trial`, `fix/push-remote-and-cas-classifier` — `gm-heads-service` and `git-meta-local-trial` and `main` all point at the same commit `427177c` ("Add write engine + Huma OpenAPI"). Remote: `github.com/entirehq/git-meta-service.git`.

**Working tree**: dirty — modified: `internal/api/api.go`, `internal/api/auth.go`, `internal/engine/engine.go`, `internal/gitclient/client.go`, `internal/gitmeta/apply.go`, `internal/gitmeta/serialize.go`, `internal/store/store.go`; untracked: `cmd/gitmeta-localtrial/`, `cmd/gitmeta-verify/`, `internal/engine/cas_test.go`.

**Purpose**: Centralized, Kubernetes-hosted Go service implementing the [git-meta](https://git-meta.com) exchange format as a queryable, API-accessible part of the Entire platform, staying byte-compatible with the upstream `git meta` Rust CLI (interop over plain Git refs). Lets callers set/query `(target, key, value)` metadata (string/list/set) on git objects (commits, branches, paths, change-ids, or whole project) without needing the CLI.

**Tech stack**: Go 1.26.4; Huma v2 (OpenAPI framework); go-git/v6 (smart-HTTP git client, mTLS); pgx/v5 + goose (Postgres + migrations, read-model); nats.go (JetStream); caarlos0/env (env-bound config). Docker Compose for local Postgres (port 55432) + NATS (client 54222, monitoring 58222).

**Directory structure**:
```
cmd/git-meta-service/    entrypoint (main.go) + Dockerfile
cmd/gitmeta-localtrial/  (untracked, WIP local-trial CLI)
cmd/gitmeta-verify/      (untracked, WIP verify CLI)
internal/gitmeta/        exchange-format engine: treepath, serialize, materialize, apply, commit
internal/config/         env-bound config (ENTIRE_-prefixed)
internal/logging/        JSON structured logging
internal/service/        wiring: config+logging+HTTP+NATS+Postgres+gitclient
internal/store/          Postgres read-model + goose migrations
internal/gitclient/      go-git/v6 smart-HTTP fetch/CAS-push vs entiredb
internal/sync/           NATS consumer + materializer (lazy backfill)
internal/api/            Huma/OpenAPI handlers + auth (auth.go)
internal/mtls/           mTLS client config loading
internal/refevent/       ref-event types
internal/engine/         write engine (Apply, CAS, retries)
```

**API surface** (`/api/v1/repos/{repoId}/...`, Huma/OpenAPI, all require `Authorization: Bearer <scoped JWT>`):
- `POST .../meta/set` — set string value
- `POST .../meta/rm` — remove key (tombstone)
- `POST .../meta/list/push` / `.../meta/list/rm` — list append/remove
- `POST .../meta/set/add` / `.../meta/set/rm` — set add/remove member
- `POST .../meta/cas` — compare-and-set (value-level; 412 on precondition fail, 409 on ref-race exhaustion)
- `GET .../meta` — query metadata by target (`?target=&key=&prefix=`)
- `GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz` (readyz pings Postgres)

Auth: `Authenticator` interface validates scoped JWT → `Principal{RepoID, CanPush, Author, Token}`. Production authenticator (validating against entire-core JWKS via `entire.io/server/auth`) not yet wired — service defaults to `NotConfiguredAuthenticator` (fails closed); `DevAuthenticator`/`LocalTrialAuthenticator` exist for local dev only (parse `gm-dev.<repoID>.<pull|push>.<email>` tokens).

**What it stores/serves**: Git is the source of truth — writes are serialized and CAS-pushed to `refs/meta/main` in entiredb via git-receive-pack (forwarding caller's JWT so push authz matches what they already have on the repo). The resulting commit is materialized into Postgres, which serves reads as a fast, rebuildable read-model. A NATS JetStream consumer listens to entiredb ref events and proactively materializes out-of-band `refs/meta/*` pushes (made via the upstream CLI directly) using a read-only mTLS service identity. No metadata derivation/autonomous writeback in v1.

**Integration with other Entire services**:
- **entiredb**: git backend (smart-HTTP fetch/push over mTLS to `ENTIRE_GIT_META_ENTIREDB_GIT_URL`), JWKS auth source, NATS ref-event publisher. Blocked on two prerequisite entiredb changes noted in README: unblocking `refs/meta/*` pushes (currently denylisted in `server/githttp/receive_pack.go`) and registering a read-only `git-meta` service identity (`internal/entireserver/svctok_listener.go`).
- **entire.io**: auth convention shared (`ENTIRE_`-prefixed env vars); production JWT validation expected to import `entire.io/server/auth`.
- Config required: `ENTIRE_POSTGRES_DSN`, `ENTIRE_NATS_URL`, `ENTIRE_GIT_META_ENTIREDB_GIT_URL`, `ENTIRE_GIT_META_JWKS_URL`; optional TLS/namespace/limits vars. HTTP listens on `:8080` by default.

**Test commands**: `go test ./...` (engine golden test round-trips against the real `git meta` Rust CLI if present locally — `internal/gitmeta/golden_test.go`), `go build ./...`. No Makefile; Dockerfile exists at `cmd/git-meta-service/Dockerfile`.

**Repo-local tooling**: has its own `.claude/` (settings.json with entire-cli hooks for PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart/Stop/UserPromptSubmit + one custom agent `entire-search.md`), `.codex/` (config.toml, hooks.json, agents/), and `.entire/settings.json` (`{"enabled": true, "telemetry": true}`).

---

## B) /Users/suhaan/devenv root tooling

**mise.toml** — defines 4 tasks:
- `setup` → runs `./setup-repos.sh`
- `dev` → runs `./start-dev.sh`
- `dev-reset` → `cd entire && mise run dev:reset`
- `copy-protos` → copies protobuf files from `entire/proto/publicapi` into `entire.io/frontend/proto/publicapi`

**setup-repos.sh**: clones (HTTPS-first, SSH fallback) three repos into devenv root — `entiredb` (`entirehq/entiredb.git`), `entire.io` (`entirehq/entire.io.git`), `cli` (`entireio/cli.git`). Then registers devenv as a trusted mise config path and runs `mise trust` inside each cloned repo. Note: root `README.md`/`Onboarding.md` describe cloning `entire` + `entire.io` (older naming), while `setup-repos.sh` actually clones `entiredb` + `entire.io` + `cli` — naming has drifted from docs.

**start-dev.sh** (orchestration):
1. Requires `entiredb/` and `entire.io/` to already exist (errors if not).
2. Deletes stale `.env`, kills any existing Rails server PID (`entire.io/tmp/pids/server.pid`).
3. Sets `ENTIRE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080`, `ENTIRE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY=true`.
4. Starts `entiredb` via `mise run dev` in background (own process group), logs to `../entire.log`.
5. Polls `https://127.0.0.1:9000/status` waiting for Raft consensus (`"groups":{"0":"voter","1":"voter"}`), up to 120s.
6. **Bootstrap**: runs `go run ./cmd/entiredb bootstrap --config bootstrap.dev.yaml` inside entiredb (idempotent — tolerates "already initialized").
7. Starts `entire.io`: `mise run install` (logged to `../entire.io.log`), then `mise run dev` with **OAuth bootstrap env vars** hardcoded for local dev: `ENTIRE_CLIENT_ID=entire-frontend-dev`, `ENTIRE_CLIENT_SECRET=entire-frontend-dev-secret`, `VITE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=entire-frontend-dev`.
8. Creates a default test user via `go run ./cmd/entiredb auth signup test password1234 "Test user" test-user@entire.io 123456` (idempotent).

<result># Architecture Brief: `/Users/suhaan/devenv/cli` (entireio/cli)

## 1. Purpose

Entire CLI is a Git-native tool that captures AI coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Factory AI Droid, Copilot CLI, Pi, and a deterministic test fake "Vogon") as structured, versioned "checkpoints" tied to git commits. ## 4. Main Entry Points and Command Structure

- **`cmd/entire/main.go`**: builds `cli.NewRootCmd()`, handles OS signal → context cancellation with correct exit codes (130/143), plugin dispatch (`MaybeRunPlugin` for kubectl-style external commands), rejects retired auth env vars, prints checkpoint-policy warnings post-run.

### Command tree (noun-group model; canonical form + legacy hidden shortcuts)
- `session` (alias `sessions`): `list`, `info`, `tokens`, `stop`, `attach`, `adopt`, `resume`, `current`

- Top-level: `enable`, `disable`, `status`, `login`, `logout`, `clean`, `version`, `dispatch`, `activity`, `help`, `configure`, `agent-help`, `api` (authenticated passthrough to core/cell HTTP APIs), `labs`, `plugin`

## 5. Key Concepts / Domain Objects

- **Session**: unit of work (`strategy/session.go`) — ID, description, strategy, start time, list of Checkpoints. State tracked in `.git/entire-sessions/` (shared across worktrees).
- **Checkpoint**: point-in-time snapshot within a session — CheckpointID (12-hex or ULID), message, timestamp, task-vs-session flag, tool-use ID.
  - **Ephemeral** checkpoints: full state snapshot on a per-worktree **shadow branch** (`entire/<HEAD-hash[:7]>-<worktreeHash[:6]>`), used for intra-session rewind.
  - **Persistent** checkpoints: condensed metadata + commit ref on the permanent `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, created on user commits.
- **Manual-commit Strategy** (`strategy/manual_commit*.go`): implements the `Strategy` interface (`SaveStep`, `SaveTaskStep`, `GetRewindPoints`/`Rewind`, `GetSessionLog`/`GetSessionInfo`); never touches the user's active branch/history; uses git-plumbing in-memory tree builds; safe on main/master.

- **OPF (OpenAI Privacy Filter)**: 9th redaction layer applied at pre-push time (not post-commit) that rewrites unpushed v1 commits, tagging them `Entire-OPF-Applied: true`.
- **Checkpoint Backends**: pluggable — git-branch (legacy, `entire/checkpoints/v1`) vs git-refs (newer, one-ref-per-checkpoint; see `docs/architecture/ref-checkpoint-backend.md`), selectable via `ENTIRE_CHECKPOINTS_PRIMARY`/`ENTIRE_CHECKPOINTS_MIRRORS`.
- **Agents**: pluggable integrations under `cmd/entire/cli/agent/{claudecode,codex,copilotcli,cursor,factoryaidroid,geminicli,opencode,pi,vogon}` implementing a common `Agent` interface for hook install + session-file parsing.
- **Cluster / Cell / Jurisdiction**: control plane ("core") is single global entity resolving to a cluster; data plane (entire-api) is deployed per-jurisdiction "cell" (e.g. `aws-us-east-2.api.entire.io`) — repo-scoped, user-scoped (`/me`, home-cell only), and fan-out routing shapes exist (`cell_target.go`, `cell_fanout.go`).
- **Investigate / Review / Recap / Experts**: experimental multi-agent workflows for provenance-driven code investigation, automated review profiles, session recap, and expert-agent querying.

- **Unit tests**: colocated `*_test.go` next to source across `cmd/`, `internal/`, `api/`, `redact/`, `perf/`. Run: `mise run test` (gotestsum wrapper) or `go test ./...`.

<result># EntireDB Architecture Brief

## 1. Purpose

`entiredb` (module `entire.io`) is the monorepo implementing **Entire**, a distributed Git repository hosting system, split into two planes that both live in this one repo: the **data plane** (`entire-server`/`entiredb` binary — git smart HTTP, content-addressed object storage, peer-to-peer replication via a Kademlia DHT, backed by PostgreSQL for refs and BadgerDB for objects) and the **control plane** (`entire-core` binary — identity, OAuth/OIDC login, JWKS issuance, SpiceDB-backed authorization, repo lifecycle/provisioning, backed by CockroachDB + SpiceDB). It also houses supporting binaries (backup/restore, operator CLI, CI-webhook bridge, mock IdP) and a React frontend served by `entire-core`. Despite the name, it is not "just" a database layer — it's the full backend (both planes) for the Entire product; the actual user-facing CLI (`entire`, `git-remote-entire`) lives in a separate sibling repo (`github.com/entireio/cli`).

**Language/stack:** Go 1.26.4 (single `go.mod`, module `entire.io`), React 19 + Vite + TypeScript frontend (pnpm) embedded into the `entire-core` binary via `embed.go`. RPC: Connect/gRPC (protobuf, buf-generated) for internal/peer traffic, huma/OpenAPI (REST/JSON) for user-facing APIs. Storage: PostgreSQL (refs, data-plane metadata), BadgerDB v4 (local object KV), CockroachDB (control-plane, multi-region), SpiceDB (authZ), NATS JetStream (optional event stream), AWS S3 (backups). Dev tooling via `mise-en-place` (`mise-tasks/`).

**Build/test commands:**
- `mise install` — install toolchain/deps; `mise run dev:setup` — mkcert certs + 1Password `.env`
- `mise run dev` — start local cluster (Postgres, NATS, CockroachDB, SpiceDB + entire-core + 2 storage nodes)
- `go build -tags no_antithesis_sdk -o ./bin/entire-core ./cmd/entire-core/` (pattern repeated per binary in `cmd/`); `mise run dev:publish` installs all `cmd/*` binaries to `~/go/bin`
- `mise run lint` (golangci-lint + gofmt + gofix + protobuf + gomod + shellcheck + actionlint); `mise run lint --fix`
- `mise run protobuf` — regenerate protobuf/Connect code via buf (`buf.gen.*.yaml`)
- Tests: `mise run test` (short/unit), `mise run test:integration` (long), `mise run test:simulation` (deterministic sim), `mise run test:all` (= test + integration), `mise run test:bench`, `mise run test:determinism`
- Direct: `go test -v ./path/to/package -run TestName`; `TEST_SEED=12345 go test -v ./test/...` for reproducible sim/integration runs
- Frontend: `pnpm build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`), `pnpm test` (vitest)
- CI: GitHub Actions in `.github/workflows/` (`main.yml`, `ci-integration.yml`, `verify.yml`, per-service deploy workflows)

## 2. Directory Structure (top-level, non-vendor)

**Data plane:**
- `server/` — HTTP + Connect/huma router; subpackages `githttp` (git smart HTTP), `repoapi` (user-facing REST API), `adminapi` (Connect admin API), `auth`, `breakglass`, `debugui`, `gitloader`, `refstorebackend`, `repostat`, `static`
- `refstore/` — git ref storage (PostgreSQL, with compare-and-swap)
- `objstore/` — content-addressed git object storage; pluggable backend (`DissStore` = BadgerDB + DHT); `Cid` = RepoID+type+hashtype+hash
- `diss/` — peer-to-peer object/packfile transfer gRPC service (`RemoteStorage`)
- `dht/` — Kademlia DHT: memberlist gossip membership, provider records, repair scheduler, keyed by RepoID
- `packfile/` — git packfile read/write/index/delta/repack
- `storage/` — local git-storage shim for go-git inside the server
- `gitutil/` — git operations (merge/rebase/cherry-pick/diff3/tree-walk, CAS `BatchWriter`)
- `tlog/` — transparency log (ref-change events → NATS, Merkle tile index) — note: not visible as top-level dir in initial listing but referenced by docs/CLAUDE.md (likely under `server/` or its own package)
- `mirror/`, `github/` — GitHub App integration + mirror sync
- `repostore/` — SQL store for per-repo data-plane state (mirror upstream URL, GH installation ID, push-size override), populated by core at provisioning
- `repourls/` — SQL store mapping URL path → repo ULID, used by router
- `postgres/` — pgx pool factory + goose migration runner (shared by both planes)
- `tlscert/`, `tokenstore/`, `notify/`, `taskloop/`, `repositories/`, `oppassword/`, `reqctx/` — supporting infra

**Control plane:**
- `core/` — ~40 subpackages: `api` (HTTP handlers), `coreapi` (huma REST API), `identity`, `authn`, `authz` (SpiceDB), `registry`/`resource`/`repoadmin`/`provisionerr` (repo lifecycle), `regional`/`audit`/`oidcfed`, `serviceaccount`/`servicetoken` (STS), `cluster`/`repolookup`/`mirrorrepo`, `githubapp`/`githubtokens`/`githubperms`, `permssnapshotter`, `workos`, `model`/`metrics`/`testutil`/`endtoend`

**Frontend / CLI / client:**
- `frontend/` — React 19/Vite/TS SPA, embedded into `entire-core` binary
- `client/` — CLI auth, device flow, credential helper, discovery (used by binaries in this repo, not the external `entire` CLI)
- `cmd/` — 10 binaries, each with its own `cli/` subcommand tree (see §4)
- `internal/{cliapi,cliauth,clicobra,clidial,clidocs}` — shared CLI infra
- `mockidp/` — mock OIDC provider library

**Cross-cutting:**
- `proto/` (`internalapi/{diss,repoadmin,repolookup}`, `publicapi/{admin}`) — protobuf definitions; `gen/proto` — generated code

## 3. What it Provides

- **Schema + migrations:** yes, goose-based SQL migrations (`-- +goose Up/Down`), split per-owning-package rather than centralized:
  - Data plane: `internal/migrations/*.sql` (refs, backups, repo_urls, repos, ref_event_outbox, compare_stats, various indexes) — target: single shared PostgreSQL DB
  - Control plane: `core/{identity,authn,mirrorrepo,githubperms,githubtokens,githubinsttoken,oidcfed,regional,resource,serviceaccount}/migrations/*.sql` — target: CockroachDB (`entirecore` DB), one migration set per subsystem, idempotent DDL required (`IF NOT EXISTS` everywhere) because CRDB doesn't run DDL atomically in a transaction
  - Migration runner: `postgres/migrate.go` (goose wrapper), invoked at binary startup
- **ORM/client library:** no ORM — raw SQL via `pgx`/`pgxpool` (`internal/pgutil`, `internal/pgxtrace`) with hand-rolled store types (`refstore.PostgresStore`, `repostore.Store`, `repourls.Store`, etc.), each owning `InitSchema`/CRUD methods directly
- **Embedded DB:** yes — BadgerDB v4 (`objstore`) as local embedded KV store for git objects on each storage node, replicated peer-to-peer via the DHT rather than via a distributed DB
- **Data model (main entities):**
  - `refs` (repo_id, ref_name, value/sha, updated_at) — git refs, PK (repo_id, ref_name), `ref_name` COLLATE "C" for prefix scans
  - `repos` (repo_id PK, mirror_upstream_url, mirror_app_installation_id, max_push_size_bytes, repo_group_id, mirror_initial_sync_done, created_at/updated_at) — per-repo data-plane state, populated by core at provisioning
  - `repo_urls` (url PK, repo_id, created_at) — URL path → repo ULID resolution
  - `compare_stats` (repo_id, base_tree, head_tree, files blob, truncated) — cached diff results, immutable, keyed by tree pair
  - `backups`, `ref_event_outbox` — backup bookkeeping and ref-change event outbox
  - Git objects: not in SQL — content-addressed `Cid{Version, RepoID, ContentType, HashType, Hash}` stored in BadgerDB / packfiles on disk
  - Control-plane (CockroachDB): `accounts`, `handles` (provider+handle, provider_user_id), `public_profiles`, `credentials` (identity); plus per-subsystem tables for mirror repos, GitHub perms/tokens/installations, OIDC federation bindings, regional/PII data, service accounts, erasure/audit ledgers

## 4. Consumers

- **`github.com/entireio/cli`** (external sibling repo, referenced throughout docs/README/CLAUDE.md) — the actual user-facing `entire` CLI (`org`/`project`/`repo`/`grant`/`mirror` subcommands) and the `git-remote-entire` Git remote helper. It authenticates against this repo's `entire-core` and talks git/Connect protocols to `entire-server`; installed via `go install github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire@main`.
- **`../entire-api`** (sibling repo, referenced in README/docs/posthog-git-events.md) — appears to be another service consuming/paralleling entire-core's auth and analytics conventions (mirrors entire-core's env-var and PostHog client patterns); README notes its jurisdiction-audience `.env` dependency on this repo.
- **`../fleet`** (sibling repo) — GitOps/deployment repo wiring these binaries into clusters (not a code consumer, but downstream of build artifacts).
- This repo's own binaries are mutual consumers: `entire-core` calls into `entire-server` (`repoadmin.CreateRepo` etc.) over mTLS service tokens; `entire-server` calls back to `entire-core` for authz checks; `entiredbctl`/`entire-backup`/`entire-repo` are operator/CLI consumers of the data plane.
- No `go.mod` reference to `entireio/cli` or `entire-api` was found in this repo's dependency graph — the relationship is one-directional (they depend on entiredb's APIs/binaries, not the reverse), confirmed by docs-only mentions plus zero appearance in `go.mod`.

## 5. Storage Engines

- **PostgreSQL** — git refs (CAS), data-plane repo metadata, repo_urls, compare_stats cache, backup coordination. Required.
- **BadgerDB v4** (`dgraph-io/badger`) — embedded local KV store for git objects/packfiles per storage node (DISS mode only).
- **CockroachDB** — control-plane database (`entirecore`), multi-region (`SET PRIMARY REGION`), used by `entire-core` for identity/authz/registry/etc.
- **SpiceDB** (backed by CockroachDB datastore) — relationship-based authorization engine for the control plane.
- **NATS JetStream** — optional event stream for transparency-log (tlog) ref-change events; skipped entirely if `ENTIRE_NATS_URL` unset.
- **AWS S3** — optional backup destination for `entire-backup`.
- **Filesystem** — large packfiles (`.pack`/`.idx`) stored directly on disk rather than in BadgerDB.
- No consensus protocol (Raft/Paxos) by design (ADR `20260320-no-raft.md`) — correctness via content-addressing + Postgres CAS + DHT quorum replication (K-closest nodes, ≥2 successes across ≥2 AZs).

## 6. Test Layout & How to Run

- **Unit tests:** co-located with source (`*_test.go` alongside implementation, e.g. `refstore/postgres_store_test.go`). 945 total `*_test.go` files (excluding `frontend/`).

- **Test helpers:** `test/testcore/`, `test/testgit/`, `test/testserver/`, `test/testutils/`, `test/workloads/`.
- **Frontend tests:** `frontend/` uses vitest (`pnpm test`).
- **Run commands:**
  - `mise run test` — short/unit (sets `ENTIRE_REFSTORE_BACKEND=postgresql`, Postgres/SpiceDB/CockroachDB DSNs; needs `mise run dev:prereqs` sidecars up first)
  - `mise run test --race` — race detector
  - `mise run test:integration` — long tests, same env prerequisites
  - `mise run test:simulation` — sim tests, one seed/process each
  - `mise run test:all` = `test` + `test:integration`
  - `mise run test:bench` — benchmarks (`packfile`, `objstore`, `tlog`, `server`, `gitutil`, `internal/go-git`), optionally pulling fixture bundles from S3
  - `mise run test:determinism` — verifies simulation-test output is bit-identical across repeated runs with the same seed
  - Direct: `go test -v ./path -run TestName`; CI mirrors these via `.github/workflows/{main,ci-integration,verify,oidf-conformance}.yml`</result>

<result># Architecture Brief: entire.io

## 1. Purpose

Entire is a web app for viewing/managing AI coding-agent activity against GitHub repos — "trails" (work items/PRs with agent runs, review, approvals), coding-agent "sessions" (transcripts of agent tool calls), commit/checkpoint attribution (human vs. agent authored lines), code review, dispatches (agent run triggers), and repo runners/settings. Root repo (`entire.io/`) is a pnpm monorepo containing the BFF API, the React SPA frontend, a marketing site, and E2E tests, sitting in front of a separate backend called "entire-core"/"entire-db" (multi-tenant, jurisdiction/cell-routed) and legacy PlanetScale/MySQL storage owned directly by this repo.

## Tech stack / commands

- **API (BFF)**: Cloudflare Workers + Hono 4, `hono-openapi` for OpenAPI docs, Kysely + MySQL (Planetscale) for local domain data, Cloudflare KV (sessions/cache), Durable Objects (runner scheduler, editor docs, trail/repo watch), Cloudflare Queues (webhooks, repo sync, search index, sandbox runs), OpenTelemetry → Honeycomb/Datadog. Zod for validation. No framework like Express — raw Hono app.
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite 8 (not Next.js/Remix), TanStack Router (file-based, code-gen'd route tree) + TanStack Query, TailwindCSS 4, Storybook, Tiptap (rich text/collaborative editor with Yjs), Shiki (code highlighting), `@pierre/diffs` (diff rendering).
- **website/**: separate marketing site (`entire-website`) using TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers, deployed independently (partial.to branding referenced in e2e).
- **e2e/**: Playwright E2E + a k6 load-testing/eval harness, also targets `partial.to`.

Commands (root `package.json` / `mise.toml`, pnpm workspaces: `api`, `frontend`, `e2e`, `website`):
- Install/setup: `pnpm install`, `mise run setup` / `scripts/setup`
- Dev: `mise run api` (port 8787, needs MySQL via `api-db-start`/`api-db-migrate`), `pnpm --filter entire-playground run dev` / `mise run frontend` (port 5173), `pnpm --filter entire-website run dev` (port 3100)
- Build: `pnpm frontend:build`, `pnpm website:build`
- Test: root `pnpm test` = `pnpm -r --parallel run test:run`; `pnpm api:test` (vitest, needs MySQL test DB via `mise run api-test`), `pnpm api:test:unit` (config-isolated unit subset), `pnpm frontend:test`, `pnpm website:test`; e2e via `pnpm --filter entire.io-e2e test` (Playwright)
- Lint/typecheck: `pnpm lint` (oxlint per package), `pnpm typecheck` (tsc --noEmit per package), `pnpm lint:deps` (knip)
- DB: `pnpm --filter entire-api run db:migrate` / `db:reset` / `db:codegen` (Kysely, migrations in `api/db/migrations`)
- OpenAPI/SDK sync: `pnpm --filter entire-api run openapi:generate` then `pnpm --filter entire-playground run api:sdk` (generates typed frontend SDK from BFF's `describeRoute()` docs into `frontend/src/gen/api-sdk`)

## 2. Directory structure (top-level)

- `api/` — Cloudflare Workers BFF (Hono): routes, auth, DB access, entire-core/entire-db proxying, queues/DOs/cron
- `frontend/` — React SPA ("entire-playground"): TanStack Router pages, domain modules, generated API SDK
- `website/` — separate marketing/landing site (TanStack Start), deployed as its own Worker
- `e2e/` — Playwright E2E tests + k6 load tests + an "eval" harness (Claude-based scoring, per package.json's `@anthropic-ai/sdk` dep)
- `docs/` — root-level docs (`setup.md`, `feature-flags.md`); each package also has its own `docs/`
- `scripts/` — repo-wide scripts (setup, feature-flag generation/sync, Claude/Codex hook formatters, Conductor worktree helpers)
- `mise-tasks/` — additional mise task definitions beyond `mise.toml`
- `otel-collector/` — OpenTelemetry collector config for local/dev telemetry
- `patches/` — pnpm patched-dependency files (e.g. `@microlabs/otel-cf-workers`)
- `.entire/` — local agent metadata/runner/log state (tool-generated, not app source)

## 3. BFF layer (api/)

**Entry**: `api/src/index.ts` (Worker `fetch`/`queue`/cron handlers, OTel instrumentation) wraps `api/src/app.ts` (Hono app + all route registration + OpenAPI doc/Scalar reference at presumably `/reference`).

**Upstream services it talks to** (three distinct backends, all under `api/src/lib/`):
- `entire-core/` — auth/identity/token-exchange service. Handles GitHub OAuth login exchange, mints per-jurisdiction "identity"/"repo" tokens (JWT), lists clusters/mirrors, resolves home jurisdiction. Config via `ENTIRE_CORE_BASE_URL` + client id/secret (client-credentials-style OAuth).
- `entire-api/` (aka "entire-api cell") — the actual trails/sessions/checkpoints backend, sharded across jurisdictions/"cells". `lib/entire-api/proxy.ts`: BFF resolves a repo's cell via `resolveCell`, exchanges the browser session's login JWT for a jurisdiction token (`mintJurisdictionToken`), then proxies the request to `entire-api` — both resolution and token are cached in Workers `caches.default`/KV. Comment in code: "Fail-outright: once we route here there is no local fallback — a BFF-side failure is a 401/502, and entire-api's own response passes through verbatim." Anonymous read support (`proxy-anonymous.ts`) for unauthenticated repo access behind a PostHog flag.
- `entire-db/` — separate "repoapi" service (code/file browsing, likely git-backed) proxied via `lib/entire-db/proxy.ts` / `repo-api.ts`; routed in `routes/entire-repo.ts` under `/api/v1/entire/repos/gh/:owner/:repo/*`, gated by `ENTIRE_DB_API_ENABLED`, running "in parallel to the go-git-api Connect path" (there's also a Connect-RPC client, `@connectrpc/connect`, for a `gitread`/`peregrine` gRPC-generated service — see `api/src/gen/{gitread,peregrine}`).

**Auth flow** (`api/src/routes/auth.ts`, `lib/github.ts`, `lib/session.ts`, `lib/entire-core/core-login.ts`):
1. GitHub OAuth (App/OAuth flow): `exchangeCodeForToken`, `getGitHubUser`, GitHub App installations (`fetchUserInstallations`/`fetchInstallationRepos`).
2. On success: BFF creates its own session (`createSession` → random UUID token stored in Cloudflare KV, 7-day TTL, cookie-based) and separately exchanges/stores "core" OAuth tokens (`putCoreTokens`/`coreTokenBundleFromResponse`) for entire-core.
3. Per-request, `lib/entire-core/core-login.ts` (`getValidLoginJwt`) refreshes/validates the core login JWT; `jurisdiction-token.ts` mints short-lived, audience-scoped jurisdiction tokens for calling entire-api/entire-db per repo.
4. CSRF cookie set via `setCsrfCookie`; `requireAuth`/`optionalAuth`/`rateLimitUnauthenticated` middleware in `lib/middleware.ts`; waitlist gating (`waitlistOAuthGate`, PostHog flag `FLAG_WAITLIST_ENFORCEMENT`); GitHub org-membership check (`checkEntireOrgMembership`).
5. Feature flags/PostHog person properties returned in auth bootstrap payload alongside embedded repo preferences (which themselves are either PlanetScale-sourced or entire-api-sourced depending on a "preferences" migration flag — `entireApiPreferencesEnabled`).

**Route inventory** (`api/src/routes/`, ~51k LOC across routes incl. tests): `auth`/`auth-dev`/`auth-onboarding`, `me`, `cache` (GitHub repo/contrib/follower/starred/watched caches, checkpoint/session/commit reads), `cli`/`cli-auth-retired` (CLI OAuth device flow), `code-review`/`code-review-stream`, `code-search`, `dispatches` (agent-run triggers/setups), `entire-core` (proxy passthrough to core), `entire-repo` (proxy to entire-db repoapi), `preferences`, `recap`, `repo-overview`, `repos-stream`, `repositories`/`repositories-available`, `runners`/`runners-dev` (self-hosted runner config), `runs` (sandbox agent runs: create/list/prompt/stream/destroy/snapshots), `trails` (list/create/detail/update/delete/threads/approvals/review/diff), `webhooks` (GitHub webhook ingestion). Domain libs (`api/src/lib/`): `agents`, `commits`, `db`, `editor-documents` (collaborative Tiptap+Yjs via Durable Object), `fix-ci`, `gates`, `git-source`, `planetscale`, `preferences`, `repos-federation`, `sandbox-runs`, `trails`, `transcript-parsers` (agent session transcript parsing), `webhook`, `search-worker`.

**Background processing**: Cloudflare Queue consumers for webhook retries, repo sync, user-repo sync, search indexing, checkpoint/trail analysis batches, session naming, sandbox-run events, repo wipe; Durable Objects for `RunnerScheduler`, `EditorDocument`, `RepoWatch`/`TrailWatch`; cron handlers for hourly git-source sync, repo retention, sandbox-run reaping, PostHog flag refresh.

## 4. Frontend (frontend/src/)

**Routing**: TanStack Router, file-based under `routes/`, tree rooted at `__root.tsx`. Layout hierarchy: `_app.tsx` → `_app/_authenticated.tsx` (gated) and `_app/_repo.tsx` (repo-scoped layout) → `_app/_repo/gh/$org.$repo.*` (per-repo pages, `gh` segment reserved for future non-GitHub forges).

**Main pages/views** (under `_app/_repo/gh/$org.$repo.*`, backed by `domains/platform/*/pages`):
- Repo overview/dashboard: `$org.$repo.overview.index.tsx` → `repo-overview` domain (analytics, breakdowns)
- Trails: `$org.$repo.trails.index.tsx` (list) + `$org.$repo.trails.$number.{-$slug}.tsx` (detail) → `domains/platform/trails/pages/{TrailsPage,TrailDetailPage}.tsx` — the core "PR-like" work-item view with status, timeline, review diffs, approvals, threads, attachments, monitor section
- Sessions (agent transcripts): `$org.$repo.sessions.$branch(.index).tsx`, `$org.$repo.session.$sessionId.tsx` → `domains/platform/sessions/pages/{SessionsPage,SessionDetailPage}.tsx`, with `SessionTimelineView` rendering transcript messages
- Commits/checkpoints: `$org.$repo.commit.$commitSha.{-$branch}.tsx`, `$org.$repo.commits.$branch(.index).tsx` → `domains/platform/checkpoints/pages/CommitDetailPage.tsx` (human/agent attribution)
- Code browsing: `domains/platform/code` (`CodeDrawer`, `CodeFileTree`, `CodeFileView` w/ Shiki highlighting) — talks to entire-db repoapi
- Runners: `$org.$repo.runners.index.tsx` / `.$runId.tsx` → `domains/platform/runners`
- Repo settings/analytics: `$org.$repo.settings.index.tsx`, `$org.$repo.analytics.index.tsx`
- Cross-repo pages: `dispatches.index/.new/.$dispatchId/.setups.$setupId`, `admin.tsx`, `repositories.tsx`, `search.tsx`, `overview.index.tsx`, `new.tsx`; top-level marketing/auth: `index`, `login`, `start`, `waitlist`

**State management**: no Redux/Zustand/Jotai — server state via TanStack Query (`queryClient` in `lib/queryClient`, generated hooks in `gen/api-sdk/react-query.gen`, custom `useOptimisticMutation`/`useOptimisticTrailMutation` for optimistic UI), URL state via TanStack Router search params + `lib/url-filters` (`useUrlFilters`), auth/theme/cookie-consent via light custom React Context providers (`AuthProvider`, `ThemeProvider`, `CookieConsentProvider` composed in `app/providers.tsx`), misc local state via hooks (`usePersistentState` for localStorage, `useSearchParamState`, `useDebouncedValue`, `useEventSourceSubscription` for SSE streaming of runs/dispatches).

**Component organization**: domain-driven, not purely atomic-design. `domains/platform/<domain>/{pages,components,hooks,lib,types}` per feature (trails, sessions, checkpoints, code, commits, dispatches, runners, repositories, repo-overview, repo-settings, repo-preferences, search, users, onboarding, admin, filter-tabs, session-sharing, auth, components(shared cross-domain: collaborative-editor, detailHeader, diff)); `domains/marketing` for landing/blog content. Shared/reusable UI sits outside domains in `components/` (charts: BarChart/BubbleChart/LineChart/HorizontalBarList, Combobox, filters, icons) and `molecules/`. `app/` holds app shell (`AppRouter`, `ErrorFallback`, `DefaultNotFound/Pending`, command palette). `gen/api-sdk` is generated (do-not-edit) typed SDK + React Query hooks from the BFF's OpenAPI spec.

## 5. Key domain objects (MySQL/Kysely schema in `api/db/schema.ts`, ~50 tables)

- **Repos** / **UserRepos** / **Installations** / **UserInstallations** — GitHub repo + App installation linkage
- **RepoTrails** + **TrailThreads** / **TrailThreadMessages** / **TrailThreadEvents** (+event sequence) / **TrailAttachments** (images/files: `r2_key`, `content_type`, `width`/`height`, `kind`) — the "trail" work-item aggregate with threaded discussion and attached images stored in R2
- **RepoCheckpoints** (+ **RepoCheckpointAnalyses/-Labels/-Mcp/-Skills/-ToolMix**, **RepoCheckpointCommits**, **RepoCheckpointTranscripts**) — an agent "checkpoint" = a captured coding-agent session tied to commits, with token usage, human/agent line-attribution (`attribution_agent_lines`, `attribution_human_added/modified/removed`), model, tool-call/skill/MCP analysis
- **RepoSessions**, **SandboxRuns** / **SandboxRunEvents** / **SandboxRunPrompts** / **SandboxSnapshots** / **SandboxSnapshotBuilds** — live/executed agent runs in sandboxes (Daytona/E2B SDKs present in deps)
- **RepoCommits** / **RepoBranchCommits** / **RepoBranchSyncState** / **CodeVersions** — commit/branch tracking, code snapshots for diffing
- **Reviews** / **ReviewComments** / **CommentLocations** / **CommentLinks** / **SuggestedChanges** / **CodeReviewEvents** — code review domain (comments anchored to code locations, suggested edits, event-sourced)
- **RepoGateDefinitions** / **RepoTrailGateResults** / **RepoTrailMonitorResults** — CI/quality "gates" and monitors on trails
- **RepoPullRequests** — linked GitHub PRs
- **EditorDocuments** — collaborative Tiptap/Yjs documents (trail body editor)
- **Users** / **OrgMemberships** / **UserPreferences** / **UserRepoPreferences** / **UserRunnerSetups** / **SessionShares** / **GithubEmailMappings** — identity, preferences, sharing, runner config

- **api/**: Vitest, config `api/vitest.config.ts` (Node pool, MySQL-backed integration tests) + `vitest.unit.config.ts` (pure-unit subset, no DB). <result>## entire-api — Architecture Brief

### 1. Purpose / stack
`entire-api` (module `github.com/entirehq/entire-api`) is Entire's **per-jurisdiction product API**: one HTTP surface serving Entire's domain objects (repos, checkpoints, sessions, trails, my_activity/`/me`) and fronting the cell's git data plane. It merged the former `activity` and `api-gateway` services. Returns residency-safe **pointers/aggregates only**; actual git content (commits, diffs, transcripts) is read-through at request time from **entiredb** (the regional git server / Repo API), never persisted locally except as a product overlay. Deployed once per jurisdiction (US/EU/AU/SG/…), each region fully self-contained except for cross-region forwarding of an author's own activity to their home region.

- **Language**: Go 1.26.4.
- **Key libs**: `danielgtaylor/huma/v2` (HTTP+OpenAPI), `go-chi/chi/v5` (mux), `jackc/pgx/v5` (Postgres), `pressly/goose/v3` (migrations), `nats-io/nats.go` + embedded `nats-server` (JetStream), `authzed/authzed-go` (SpiceDB client), `anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go` (LLM analysis/session-naming), `aws-sdk-go-v2` (S3/KMS for snapshot/attachment blobs), `spf13/cobra` (CLI), OpenTelemetry SDK, `go-git/v6`.
- **Build/run**: `mise` task runner (`mise.toml`); tasks live as scripts under `mise-tasks/`.
  - `mise run build` — go build; `mise run vet`; `mise run lint` (golangci-lint) / `lint:shell`.
  - `mise run dev:setup` — bootstrap `.env`, start Postgres (docker, `:15432`), migrate.
  - `mise run dev` — run api + both workers locally.
  - `mise run run:api` / `run:repo` / `run:user` — run one binary alone.
  - `mise run migrate` — goose migrations via `MIGRATE_DATABASE_DSN`.
  - Requires a sibling `../entiredb` checkout for full local dev (auth JWKS, git plane).
- **Test**: `mise run test` (unit), `test:integration` (store vs throwaway PG, needs Docker), `test:pipeline` (wired `/me/*` HTTP vs PG+NATS), `test:multicellular`, `test:perf` (opt-in, p95 budget), `test:race`, `test:attachments`.

### 2. Directory structure (top-level)
- `cmd/` — binary entrypoints: `api`, `repo-activity`, `user-activity`, `experts-demo` (demo server), `import-planetscale` (one-off legacy MySQL importer).
- `internal/` — ~65 packages, all business logic (see §3/§4/§5).
- `docs/` — `architecture.md` (deep reference), `jobs.md` (consumer/job inventory), `observability.md`, `adr/` (3 ADRs), `runbooks/` (12 ops runbooks), `diagrams/` (SVGs), `data-flow.py`/`topology.py` (diagram generators).
- `mise-tasks/` — one script per task (build/dev/lint/migrate/run/test/tidy/vet), mapped by directory to `:`-namespaced task names.
- `scripts/` — `new-migration.sh` (creates UTC-timestamp-versioned goose migrations).
- `.github/workflows/` — `test.yml` (build/vet/race/pipeline/integration/multicellular/perf/lint), `deploy.yml`, `entire-api-promote.yml`.
- Root: `CLAUDE.md` (agent conventions), `CONTEXT.md` (authn/authz domain vocabulary), `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `Dockerfile`, `.env.example`, `.golangci.yml`.

### 3. Entry points / binaries / API surface
Three deployable binaries from one module, sharing `internal/server` for lifecycle (OTel + HTTP + graceful shutdown via errgroup):

| Binary | Cmd | Role | NATS | API |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | `cmd/api` | Unified HTTP server: `/me/*` (user store) + repo/project aggregates (repo store) + trails/threads/reviews/runner surfaces, in-process, plus the absorbed gateway merging entiredb's git-plane OpenAPI spec and reverse-proxying it | no | full `/api/v1/*` |
| `repo-activity` | `cmd/repo-activity` | Ref consumer (`repo_refs_v1`) + index-jobs consumer + checkpoint-analysis consumer + forwarder publisher; owns repo store | yes | health only; subcommands `serve`, `migrate`, `backfill`, `seed-repos`, `enqueue-analysis`, `replay-deferred-analysis` |
| `user-activity` | `cmd/user-activity` | Forwarder consumer writing `my_activity`; owns user store | yes | health only; `serve`, `migrate` |

All binaries: `serve`, `version`; workers add `migrate`; `api` adds `repos-for-user` (resolve a user's readable repos via SpiceDB, for piping into backfill).

Routing: chi mux + Huma v2, all under `/api/v1`, docs at `/api/v1/docs`, spec at `/api/v1/openapi.yaml`. Health: `/healthz`, `/readyz`. Optional second internal mTLS listener (`ENTIRE_INTERNAL_LISTEN_ADDR`) serves identical routes to SPIFFE-allowlisted in-cluster callers (e.g. `entire-mcp`).

**API surface (route families, from `internal/httpapi`)**:
- `/me`, `/me/commits`, `/me/checkpoints`, `/me/activity`, `/me/recap`, `/me/sessions` (+ `/api/v1/experimental/me/*` federated variants)
- `/repos`, `/repos/batch`, `/repos/{id}`, `/repos/{id}/summary|activity|contributors|agents|commits|checkpoints|checkpoints/{cid}|checkpoints/{cid}/analysis|compare|compare/contributors|sessions|branches|tree|raw|checkpoint-status`
- `/repos/{id}/overview/{commit-stats,checkpoint-metrics,agent-activity,session-patterns,contributors,contributor-tokens,contributor-agents,branch-commit-dates,pr-stats}`
- `/repos/{id}/sessions/{sid}` (+ transcript, transcript/raw, display-name PATCH, share POST/DELETE)
- `/repos/{id}/runner-settings`, `/repos/{id}/trail-settings`, `/repos/{id}/settings/public-sharing`, `/repos/{id}/meta` (git-meta GET/POST)
- `/projects/{id}/summary|repos|contributors|activity`
- **Trails** (dual-addressed: legacy `/trails/{host}/{owner}/{repo}/...` and platform `/repos/{repo_id}/trails/...`): create/get/list, `stats`, `linked-branches`, `definitions`, `gate-settings`, `gates`, `mergeability`, `approvals`, `timeline`, `attachments` (+ complete), `threads` (+ messages), `reviews` (+ comments), runner `ingest/runs/{id}`, `ingest/runs/{id}/results/{type}`, `ingest/monitors/{key}`, `runs/{runnerId}`, `monitors`.
- `/preferences/*` (session-detail-filters, diff-view, filter-tabs), `/preferences/repos*` (pinned/recent/migrate)
- `/cache/prs`, `/repos/{id}/experts` (POST), `/internal/admin`
- Auth: bearer JWT ("jurisdictional identity token") only; second scheme is anonymous short-lived JWTs minted for public-repo reads (`AnonSigner`).

### 4. Key domain objects
- **repos** — minimal metadata (owning project, jurisdiction); seeded from entire-core lifecycle events, enriched by ingest.
- **checkpoints** — per-checkpoint hydrated payload (agent/model, token/step counts, per-session JSONB, attribution, transcript offsets).
- **sessions** — materialised rollup of contributing checkpoints (custom→generated→display name precedence); session naming via LLM (`internal/sessionname`).
- **checkpoint_commits** — junction linking a checkpoint to its anchoring commit via `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer, denormalised with diffstat + commit_state (`shipped`/`in_progress`/`orphaned`) + author/pusher account ids.
- **repo_author_day** — default-branch commit-metrics rollup per `(repo, author_email, day)`; recompute-not-delta.
- **repo_checkpoint_analyses** — recap facets: deterministic (`skills`/`mcp_servers`/`tool_mix`, via `internal/analysis`) + LLM (`labels`/narrative, via `internal/checkpointanalysis`, Anthropic API, gated by `ANALYZE_CHECKPOINTS`/`ANALYZE_CHECKPOINTS_LLM`).
- **trails** (RFD-023 native port) — PR/change-proposal-like objects with definitions, gates/gate-settings, approvals, mergeability, threads/messages, reviews/comments, attachments, runner ingest/monitors — a large newer subsystem (packages `checkpointlayout`, `trailblobs`, `trailevents`, `trailsrelay`, `trailforge`, `gateconfig`, `gateeval`, `monitorenrich` under `httpapi`).
- **my_activity** (user store) — residency-safe per-author rows, keyed `(account_id, committed_at, origin_key, sha, type, checkpoint_id)`, monthly range-partitioned; `origin_key` is a placement-independent ULID so mirrors of the same GitHub repo converge to one row.
- **user_preferences** / **user_repo_preferences** — API-native settings (key/value, pinned+recent repo lists).
- **session_shares** — public-share state with wrapped DEK for encrypted snapshot (crypto-shred on unshare).
- **github_repo_meta**, **github_pull_request_meta** — GitHub display metadata from webhooks, display-only.
- **repo_runner_settings**, **sync_state**, **repo_branch_tip** — per-repo product/ingest state.
- Commit lifecycle states: `shipped` / `in_progress` / `orphaned`, ref-derived, reclassified on default-branch moves.

### 5. Storage / queues / relation to entiredb
- **Postgres**: one database per region, two schemas via `internal/store`: `repo` (owned by repo-activity, read-only for `api`) and `usr` (owned by user-activity, read-write for `api` too — API-native preference tables). Enforced by distinct Postgres roles (`repo_rw`/`repo_ro`/`user_rw`), see ADR 0001. Migrations: goose, separate version tables (`goose_activity_repo`/`goose_activity_user`), UTC-timestamp filenames, run out-of-band as k8s initContainers. `my_activity` monthly-partitioned; partitions provisioned out-of-band (`internal/store/partitions.sql`) by a scheduler, not migrations.
- **No local git replica** — commit lists, diffs, branch reachability, raw transcripts are read-through to **entiredb** at request time (repo API), cached TTL keyed by branch tip (mutable-history pages) or by `(repo,sha)` (immutable point reads, no TTL).
- **NATS/JetStream**: per-cluster island (no supercluster). Streams: `repo_refs_v1` (shared ref events, consumed by `activity-ingester`), `repo_index_jobs` + `repo_index_jobs_backfill` (WorkQueue, `activity-index-jobs`), `repo_checkpoint_analysis_jobs` (`analysis-facets`), `user_activity_v1` (cross-region forward target), `resource_lifecycle_v1` (identity/repo/mirror/user lifecycle, multi-durable), `github_meta_v1`, `github_pr_v1`, `repo_settings_v1`, `trail_events_v1`. Cross-region delivery = direct publish into the recipient's home-cluster NATS (residency by connection choice, not filtering).
- **Object storage**: S3-compatible (AWS SDK v2 / KMS) for encrypted session-share snapshots (`internal/snapshotstore`, `snapshotcrypt`) and trail attachment blobs (`internal/trailblobs`) via presigned URLs.
- **entiredb relation**: entiredb is a *separate sibling repo* (`../entiredb` in local dev), not vendored wholesale — it is: (a) the regional **git server / Repo API** entire-api reads through to (client: `internal/repoapi`, transport failover: `internal/repotransport`); (b) the source of the **control plane** entire-core reads (client: `internal/coreapi`); (c) the origin of a **vendored package** `internal/authz` (copied from entiredb's `core/authz`, PR #2018, re-synced on merge) used as the read-only SpiceDB client; (d) shares modules `entiredb/modules/{analytics,authmtls,jwtverify,ratelimit}` as go.mod dependencies. The `api` binary also absorbs entiredb's git-plane OpenAPI spec via `internal/gateway` (merge + reverse-proxy).

### 6. Integration points
- **Auth (inbound)**: bearer JWT "jurisdictional identity token" from **entire-core**, verified against `CORE_JWKS_URL`; `aud` pinned to `ENTIRE_JURISDICTION_AUDIENCE`, `scope` must contain `openid` (`internal/auth`). No OAuth flow lives in this repo (device-code/browser login lives in entire-core / CLI). Optional anonymous short-lived JWTs for public-repo reads.
- **Authz**: regional read-only **SpiceDB** via vendored `internal/authz.Reader` (gRPC, preshared key `ENTIRE_SPICEDB_RO_KEY`), fail-closed, bounded-stale reads; per-request `AccessChecker` (`internal/auth/access.go`) caches accessible-repo set (~15s TTL).
- **entire-core** (central control plane, cert-only mTLS from this service): `GetRepo`, `AccountByID` (pusher/author home resolution), `lookupAuthorAccounts` (email→account), account-approval/waitlist check, RFC 8693 STS token exchange for GitHub trail-forge operations (`internal/trailforge`, opt-in via `TRAILS_CORE_INTERNAL_URL`).
- **entiredb / Repo API**: cert-only mTLS workload identity (SPIFFE, `internal/repoauth`), no per-repo grant — reads commits/diffs/transcripts/branch data.
- **GitHub**: via entire-core-mediated webhooks → `github_meta_v1`/`github_pr_v1` NATS streams (repo star/fork/description, PR metadata); trail-forge branch/PR/comment operations via GitHub API using STS-exchanged user tokens.
- **Anthropic API**: LLM checkpoint-analysis labels (`internal/checkpointanalysis`) and session naming (`internal/sessionname`), routed through Cloudflare AI Gateway (`internal/aigateway`), gated by env flags, with usage-cap-aware deferral (no retry-loop, park + replay runbook).
- **PostHog**: per-request `api_request` capture for backend DAU/MAU (`entiredb/modules/analytics`), best-effort/non-blocking.
- **Observability**: OpenTelemetry traces+metrics over OTLP/HTTP (`internal/otelsetup`), structured `slog` correlated to trace context, gated by `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.
- **Legacy migration**: `internal/planetscale` + `cmd/import-planetscale` — one-off read-only client/importer from the legacy `entire.io` MySQL (PlanetScale) database.

### 7. Test layout / how to run
- Unit tests: colocated `*_test.go` beside source in every `internal/*` package (~289 test files) — `mise run test` (`go test ./...`).
- `internal/multicellular` — cross-jurisdiction integration suite: real embedded-NATS + real Postgres per simulated "cell," declarative scenario files (`activity_test.go`, `settings_test.go`, `meread_test.go`, `defaultbranch_test.go`, `recap_test.go`) over a `harness` package (World/Cell/Repo/User DSL). Only suite that's cross-cell + real-transport + real-store. `mise run test:multicellular`.
- Store/integration tests (`test:integration`) — real throwaway Postgres via Docker (`fergusstrange/embedded-postgres` also used); self-skip without `ACTIVITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL`.
- `test:pipeline` — wired end-to-end `/me/*` HTTP tests vs throwaway Postgres + NATS (ingest→forward→my_activity→/me); runs on every PR in CI.
- `test:perf` — seeds ~50k rows, asserts `/me/activity` p95 budget; opt-in (PR `perf` label or `workflow_dispatch`).
- `test:race` — race detector run.
- `test:attachments` — trail-attachment blob-store specific suite.
- `idtest` and `tlstest` packages are shared test-only helpers (deterministic ULID/SHA fixtures; throwaway TLS certs).
- CI: `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs build, vet, race, pipeline, integration, multicellular, perf (opt-in), lint (golangci-lint + shellcheck).</result>

# Entire Suite — Codebase Map

> Rebuilt 2026-07-16 from a 5-agent exploration sweep (previous map was deleted).
> This is the standing architecture reference for the whole Entire org. Update it, don't re-discover.

## System architecture (big picture)

```
                          ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
                          │  entiredb repo (module entire.io) — BACKEND    │
  entire CLI ──git/http──▶│  ├─ entire-server (data plane, per-region):    │
  git-remote-entire       │  │   git smart HTTP, refs in Postgres (CAS),   │
      │                   │  │   objects in BadgerDB + Kademlia DHT        │
      │ auth/CRUD         │  │   replication, packfiles on disk, NATS tlog │
      ▼                   │  └─ entire-core (control plane, global):       │
  entire-core  ◀──────────│      identity, OAuth/OIDC login, JWKS,         │
  (auth.entire.io)        │      SpiceDB authz, repo lifecycle,            │
      │ mints             │      CockroachDB, embedded React admin UI      │
      │ jurisdiction JWTs └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
      ▼                            ▲ read-through (commits/diffs/transcripts)
  entire-api (per-jurisdiction "cell": aws-us-east-2, eu-central-1, …)
  product API: checkpoints, sessions, trails, /me activity
  Postgres (repo+usr schemas) + NATS JetStream + S3
      ▲ proxied per-repo with minted jurisdiction tokens
      │
  entire.io repo — BFF (Cloudflare Workers + Hono) + React SPA frontend
  legacy PlanetScale MySQL + KV/DO/Queues; browser talks only to BFF

  git-meta-service — sidecar service: (target,key,value) metadata on git
  objects; CAS-push to refs/meta/main in entiredb, Postgres read-model
```

**Auth token chain**: GitHub OAuth → BFF session (KV cookie) → entire-core login JWT → short-lived audience-scoped **jurisdiction tokens** per repo → entire-api/entiredb validate against core JWKS (`aud` pinned to jurisdiction). CLI has its own device flow against entire-core; `ENTIRE_TOKEN` bypass for CI. AuthZ everywhere = SpiceDB (fail-closed, read-only regional replicas).

**Residency model**: control plane global; data plane + entire-api deployed per jurisdiction (US/EU/AU/SG). Cross-region = direct publish into recipient's home-cluster NATS (residency by connection choice). entire-api returns pointers/aggregates only; git content read through entiredb at request time.

---

## Repos

### cli/ — `github.com/entireio/cli` (Go 1.26, cobra)

Entire CLI: captures AI coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor, Droid, Copilot CLI, Pi + deterministic fake "Vogon") as **checkpoints** tied to git commits. Ships `entire` + `git-remote-entire` (remote helper for `entire://`).

- **Core engine**: `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/` (manual-commit strategy). Ephemeral checkpoints on shadow branch `entire/<HEAD:7>-<worktree:6>`; persistent ones on `entire/checkpoints/v1` (legacy git-branch backend) or one-ref-per-checkpoint (newer git-refs backend, `ENTIRE_CHECKPOINTS_PRIMARY`/`_MIRRORS`). Never touches user's branch.
- **Session state**: `.git/entire-sessions/` (shared across worktrees). Transcripts: `full.jsonl` (raw) + compacted `transcript.jsonl`.
- **Agents**: pluggable under `cmd/entire/cli/agent/*` — hook install + session-file parsing. MCP stdio server (`entire mcp`) for MCP-host agents.
- **Command tree** (4 groups): Sessions & Checkpoints (`session`, `checkpoint`, `resume`…), Entire Setup (`enable`/`disable`/`agent`/`configure`/`doctor`), Account (`auth`, `login`), Control Plane (`org`/`project`/`repo`/`grant`, `api` passthrough). Experimental gated by build flag: `review`, `investigate`, `search`, `experts`, `blame`, `why`, `runner`, `tokens`. kubectl-style plugins (`entire-<name>` on PATH).
- **Clients**: `internal/coreapi` (ogen-generated from OpenAPI, control plane), `entireapi_client.go` (cells), `internal/entireclient` (contexts/tokenstore/discovery). Cell routing: repo-scoped, user-scoped (`/me`, home cell), fan-out.
- **Redaction**: `redact/` (betterleaks, PII, packs) + OPF (OpenAI Privacy Filter) pre-push layer rewriting unpushed v1 commits.
- **Commands**: `mise run check` (fmt+lint+test:ci — required pre-commit), `mise run test`, `test:integration`, `test:e2e:canary` (Vogon, safe), `test:e2e` (real agents, costs money — only on explicit ask). Test isolation rules strict: never real `.git`/`~/.config/entire`/keychain; `t.Parallel()` default.
- **Config**: `.entire/settings.json` read only via `settings` package. Env: `ENTIRE_*` (API routing, backend selection, OPF, telemetry opt-out, `ENTIRE_EXTERNALIZE_IMAGES`…).

### entiredb/ — `entirehq/entiredb`, module `entire.io` (Go 1.26 + React 19 frontend)

**The backend monorepo — both planes, despite the name.** Distributed git hosting.

- **Data plane** (`entire-server`/`entiredb` binary): `server/` (githttp smart HTTP, repoapi REST, adminapi Connect, auth, gitloader), `refstore/` (Postgres CAS refs), `objstore/` (content-addressed, `Cid` = RepoID+type+hash, BadgerDB v4), `dht/` (Kademlia, memberlist gossip, K-closest quorum ≥2 AZs), `diss/` (p2p packfile transfer gRPC), `packfile/`, `gitutil/` (merge/rebase/diff3, CAS BatchWriter), `tlog/` (transparency log → NATS Merkle tiles), `mirror/`+`github/` (GitHub App mirror sync). **No Raft by design** (ADR 20260320): content-addressing + Postgres CAS + DHT quorum.
- **Control plane** (`entire-core` binary): `core/*` ~40 pkgs — identity, authn (OAuth/OIDC + JWKS), authz (SpiceDB), registry/resource/repoadmin (lifecycle+provisioning), serviceaccount/servicetoken (STS), githubapp/tokens/perms, workos. CockroachDB (`entirecore`, multi-region, idempotent DDL). Embedded React/Vite frontend.
- **Other binaries** (`cmd/`, 10): backup/restore (S3), operator CLI `entiredbctl`, CI-webhook bridge, mock IdP.
- **RPC**: Connect/gRPC internal (buf, `proto/`), huma/OpenAPI user-facing (`api/corev1`, `api/repov1`). Vendored go-git fork under `internal/go-git`.
- **Migrations**: goose, split per owning package (data plane `internal/migrations/`, control plane `core/*/migrations/`). No ORM — raw pgx.
- **Shared modules** (`modules/`): analytics, authmtls, jwtverify, ratelimit — imported by entire-api via go.mod.
- **Commands**: `mise run dev` (local cluster: PG+NATS+CRDB+SpiceDB+core+2 storage nodes), `mise run test` / `test:integration` / `test:simulation` (synctest, `TEST_SEED=n` reproducible) / `test:determinism`, `mise run lint`, `mise run protobuf`. Conformance: full OIDF + OAuth RFC suites (`test/conformance/`).
- **Canonical docs**: `docs/repo-map.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/adrs/`, runbooks, postmortems.

### entire-api/ — `entirehq/entire-api` (Go 1.26, huma/chi/pgx/NATS)

**Per-jurisdiction product API** (merged former `activity` + `api-gateway`). Domain objects: repos, checkpoints, sessions, trails, `/me` activity. Pointers/aggregates only; git content read-through from entiredb (TTL cache keyed by branch tip; immutable by `(repo,sha)`).

- **3 binaries** sharing `internal/server`: `api` (full `/api/v1/*` HTTP + absorbed gateway reverse-proxying entiredb's git-plane spec; optional internal mTLS listener for SPIFFE callers like entire-mcp), `repo-activity` (NATS consumers: refs, index jobs, checkpoint analysis, forwarder; owns repo store; subcommands backfill/seed-repos/enqueue-analysis), `user-activity` (forwarder consumer → `my_activity`; owns user store).
- **Store**: one Postgres per region, two schemas — `repo` (repo-activity owns; api read-only) and `usr` (user-activity owns; api read-write) — enforced by PG roles (ADR 0001). Goose, separate version tables, k8s initContainers. `my_activity` monthly-partitioned, keyed by placement-independent `origin_key` ULID.
- **Domain**: checkpoints (hydrated payload, attribution, transcript offsets), sessions (rollups, LLM naming), checkpoint_commits (junction via `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer; states shipped/in_progress/orphaned), repo_author_day rollups, checkpoint analyses (deterministic facets + LLM labels via Anthropic through Cloudflare AI Gateway, `ANALYZE_CHECKPOINTS*` gates), **trails** (RFD-023: gates, approvals, mergeability, threads, reviews, attachments, runner ingest/monitors), session_shares (encrypted S3 snapshots, crypto-shred DEK), preferences.
- **NATS streams**: `repo_refs_v1`, `repo_index_jobs(+_backfill)`, `repo_checkpoint_analysis_jobs`, `user_activity_v1`, `resource_lifecycle_v1`, `github_meta_v1`, `github_pr_v1`, `repo_settings_v1`, `trail_events_v1`.
- **Auth**: inbound jurisdiction JWT vs `CORE_JWKS_URL`, `aud` pinned; anonymous short-lived JWTs for public repos. SpiceDB read-only (`internal/authz`, vendored from entiredb core/authz, re-synced on merge). mTLS SPIFFE to entiredb repoapi.
- **Commands**: `mise run dev` (api+workers; needs `../entiredb` sibling), `test`, `test:integration`, `test:pipeline` (wired /me e2e), `test:multicellular` (cross-cell harness, embedded NATS + real PG per cell), `test:perf` (opt-in p95 budget), `test:race`, `test:attachments`.
- **Docs**: `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/jobs.md`, `CONTEXT.md` (auth vocabulary), 12 runbooks.

### entire.io/ — `entirehq/entire.io` (pnpm monorepo: api / frontend / website / e2e)

Web app: trails, sessions, commit/checkpoint attribution, code review, dispatches, runners.

- **api/** — BFF on Cloudflare Workers + Hono 4 + hono-openapi. Kysely + PlanetScale MySQL (~50 legacy tables: RepoTrails/Threads/Attachments, RepoCheckpoints+analyses, SandboxRuns, Reviews/Comments, Gates, EditorDocuments…), KV (sessions), Durable Objects (RunnerScheduler, EditorDocument Yjs, Repo/TrailWatch), Queues (webhooks, sync, search index, sandbox runs), cron. Three upstreams under `api/src/lib/`: `entire-core` (login/token exchange), `entire-api` (cell proxy — resolveCell + mintJurisdictionToken, fail-outright, no local fallback; anonymous read path behind PostHog flag), `entire-db` (repoapi code browsing, `ENTIRE_DB_API_ENABLED`, plus Connect-RPC gitread/peregrine clients). Migration in flight: PlanetScale → entire-api (e.g. preferences behind `entireApiPreferencesEnabled`).
- **frontend/** — "entire-playground": React 19 + Vite + TanStack Router (file-based) + TanStack Query + Tailwind 4 + Tiptap/Yjs + Shiki + `@pierre/diffs`. Domain-driven: `domains/platform/<domain>/{pages,components,hooks}` (trails, sessions, checkpoints, code, dispatches, runners, repo-overview…). Generated SDK `gen/api-sdk` from BFF OpenAPI (`openapi:generate` → `api:sdk`). Routes: `_app/_repo/gh/$org.$repo.*` (trails, sessions, commit detail, code, runners, settings, analytics). No Redux — Query + URL state + light contexts.

content.text:
Understood the full stack. But the workflow found something that **breaks your premise** — surfacing before any run.

## What I now understand (compact)
- **entire-brain** (`Coding/entire-brain`, `github.com/ashtom/entire-brain`) = local per-repo memory plugin (`entire brain mcp`). Two layers: **facts** (LLM-extracted, NDJSON) + **semantic** (deterministic code graph in its own SQLite). Ingests by shelling out to `entire sem snapshot`, re-persists. Consumer of sem, not a wrapper.
- **entire graph** (`entire sem`, `Coding/entire-sem`, `github.com/entireio/entire-graph`) = **tree-sitter** (cgo), 1 grammar/lang, all 9 bench langs real grammars. Nodes=symbols, edges=DEFINES/CALLS/EXTENDS/… with confidence ladder (the "0.62" = C/C++ overload-set fallback rung). **C/C++ categorically weakest (0% clean graphs), Java always degraded, JS/TS cleanest.**
- **Benchmarks**: `brain-swebench` = issue-fix rate, 2 tracks (A=live local `claude -p` matrix; B=official Docker mini-swe-agent) + official SWE-bench eval. `brain-bench` = separate graph-correctness/retrieval vs competitors (DeusData CBM) against compiler ground truth.
- **Treated arm** = baseline prompt + appended `GQ_NOTE` giving a `gq` graph-query tool ("use BEFORE/INSTEAD OF grep/cat"). Retrieval interface, not context dump.

## 🚨 Critical finding — the sonnet 77% is not real
Audit of all 60 on-disk sonnet result files:
- sonnet **baseline**: 13/30 real, **16/30 `api_error 429`** (session limit)
- sonnet **treated**: **30/30 `429`** → **zero valid patches**
- No scored sonnet preds anywhere. `results/matrix_compare.md` has **no sonnet numbers** (haiku-only). grep for `27/30`/`23/30`/`90%`/`77%` → nothing.

**Root cause**: 2026-07-16 12:35 — three `run_matrix.sh` at conc=8 launched on top of the running conc=2 matrix → ~24 concurrent `claude -p` on **one subscription** → session-limit collapse at 12:43. Everything sonnet/opus after = instant `$0` 429s.

**So the 90%→77% in your screenshot is almost certainly a rate-limit artifact, not a graph effect.** This repo copy can't reproduce it (numbers likely from another machine/session/earlier-overwritten run). There is no valid sonnet accuracy drop on disk to "investigate" — the data's poisoned.

## Safe run path — and 3 blockers
Good news: **Track B (`run_pilot.sh`) bills to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (per-token), NOT the subscription** → fully isolated from the live haiku matrix, won't re-trigger 429, writes to separate `results/official_sonnet/`. This is the clean audited path.

But 3 prerequisites currently **missing**:
1. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` — not in env or mini-swe `.env` (secret; you provide)
2. `mini-swe-agent` — not installed
3. **Docker/OrbStack — DOWN** (eval needs it; you start OrbStack app)

Cost for 30/arm ≈ **$20–60** API, ~1–2h wall-clock.

Given the premise changed (no real drop — it's a 429 artifact), how proceed?

# Reads pilot30.json (== graphs/COMPLETENESS.tsv set), NOT pilot_tasks.json (300).
# Own progress file (matrix30_progress.txt) so it never muddles the live matrix_progress.txt.
# Low default concurrency (CONC=2) to avoid the subscription 429 collapse.
# Idempotent: skips a cell whose results/<model>/<arm>/<iid>/cc_out.json has cost>0 + patch.
# Launch:  MODELS=sonnet ARMS="baseline treated" CONC=2 nohup bash run_matrix30.sh > matrix30.log 2>&1 &
set -uo pipefail
ROOT=/Users/suhaan/Documents/Coding/brain-swebench
cd "$ROOT"
CONC="${CONC:-2}"
CC_MAX_TURNS="${CC_MAX_TURNS:-50}"
PROG="$ROOT/matrix30_progress.txt"
MODELS="${MODELS:-sonnet}"
ARMS="${ARMS:-baseline treated}"

IIDS="$(.venv/bin/python -c "import json;[print(i['instance_id']) for i in json.load(open('pilot30.json'))['instances']]")"

log(){ echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" >> "$PROG"; echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] $*"; }

is_done(){
  local cc="$1"
  [ -s "$cc" ] || return 1
  python3 -c "import json,sys
try:
    d=json.load(open('$cc')); sys.exit(0 if float(d.get('total_cost_usd') or 0)>0 else 1)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null
}

run_one(){
  local model="$1" arm="$2" iid="$3"
  local modeldir="${model//\//_}"
  local out="$ROOT/results/$modeldir/$arm/$iid"
  local patch="$out/patch.diff"
  if is_done "$out/cc_out.json" && [ -s "$patch" ]; then
    log "SKIP  $model/$arm/$iid (done, cost>0 + patch)"
    return 0
  fi
  CC_MODEL="$model" CC_MAX_TURNS="$CC_MAX_TURNS" bash run_cc_one.sh "$arm" "$iid" >/dev/null 2>&1
  local lines=0 cost="?" err="?"
  [ -f "$patch" ] && lines=$(wc -l <"$patch" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ -s "$out/cc_out.json" ]; then
    read -r cost err < <(python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$out/cc_out.json'));print(d.get('total_cost_usd','?'),d.get('is_error','?'))" 2>/dev/null || echo "? ?")
  fi
  local status=PASS
  [ "${lines:-0}" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null && status=EMPTY
  log "$status  $model/$arm/$iid patch=${lines}L cost=\$$cost err=$err"
}

log "=== MATRIX30 START  models=[$MODELS] arms=[$ARMS] conc=$CONC tasks=$(echo "$IIDS" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ==="
for model in $MODELS; do

  for arm in $ARMS; do
    log "----- $model / $arm -----"
    n=0
    for iid in $IIDS; do
      run_one "$model" "$arm" "$iid" &
      n=$((n+1))
      if [ $((n % CONC)) -eq 0 ]; then wait; fi
    done
    wait
    log "----- $model / $arm COMPLETE -----"
  done
  log "########## MODEL $model DONE ##########"
done

Base directory for this skill: /Users/suhaan/.claude/skills/audit

# Audit loop: fix until genuinely clean

Loop review then fix then re-verify until the code is clean from BOTH a normal reviewer's view and an adversarial bug-hunter's view. Do not stop at the first clean read. Stop only after two consecutive full passes find nothing new and build/lint/tests are green.

## Scope
Default to the current branch's diff vs the base branch (main). If the user names a file, package, or PR, scope to that. State what you are auditing before you start.

## The loop

Run these every iteration:

### Pass A: normal review lens
Read it like a careful reviewer.
- Correctness: does it do what it claims? Off-by-one, inverted conditions, missing cases, wrong defaults.
- Error handling: unchecked errors, swallowed failures, missing early returns, ignored return values.
- Maintainability: dead code, duplication, unclear naming, leftover debug, TODOs left in.
- Consistency: matches the surrounding code's patterns and the repo's conventions.

### Pass B: bugbot / adversarial lens
Now try to break it.
- Edge cases: empty, nil, zero, negative, very large, unicode, whitespace, duplicate, out-of-order.
- Concurrency: races, unsynchronized shared state, goroutine/promise leaks, deadlock.
- Resources: unclosed files/conns/handles, unbounded growth, missing timeouts/contexts.
- Security: injection, path traversal, secrets in code or logs, auth/authz gaps, unsafe deserialization, SSRF.
- Bad assumptions: stale cache, partial failure, reordering, retries that double-apply.
- For each suspected bug, construct the concrete failing input before claiming it.

### Fix
Fix everything found. Keep diffs minimal and targeted. Add or adjust a test for each real bug so it cannot regress.

### Verify the committed state
Run the repo's build + lint + full test suite. Confirm green on the actually-committed/staged tree, not an unsaved buffer. A "reset --soft then commit" or a stash can silently leave the fix out of the commit, so diff `git show HEAD` if in doubt.

### Re-loop
Go back to Pass A on the fixed code. A fix can introduce a new bug. Keep going.

## Stop condition
Exit only when a full Pass A + Pass B finds nothing new TWICE in a row AND build/lint/tests pass. Then report: what was found, what was fixed, and the verified final state.

## Rules
- Never declare clean on a single pass. The subtle bugs surface after the obvious ones are gone.
- Default to skepticism. If you cannot fix something safely because it needs a design decision or a benchmark you cannot run, stop and surface it instead of guessing.
- Report honestly: separate "fixed and verified" from "found but could not verify."
- For a large surface, fan out: review independent areas in parallel, then verify each finding adversarially before trusting it.

<result># Audit Report — PR #36 `fix(gitutil): stop misclassifying git errors as file-absent`

## Original bug (confirmed understood)
`ShowFile` classified file-absence by substring-matching the **wrapped** error (`git show REV:PATH: <stderr>`), which always echoes the argv. Any real error (bad rev, IO, ctx-cancel) on a path containing `"Path"` (e.g. `src/PathHelper.go`) matched the over-broad `"Path"` clause → returned `("", false, nil)`, silently swallowing the error. Consumed by `internal/sem/analyze.go` (`beforeOK`/`afterOK`) and `dependents.go`, so a modified file rendered as fully added/deleted or was skipped. Verified live: bad-rev stderr is `fatal: invalid object name 'BADREV'.` (path NOT echoed there), while the wrapped err was `git show BADREV:src/PathHelper.go: ...` (path echoed → matched `"Path"`).

## Build / vet / test (read-only)
- `go build ./internal/gitutil/` — OK
- `go vet ./internal/gitutil/` — OK
- `go test ./internal/gitutil/` — 7 passed. Both new tests pass individually.

## Primary fix assessment — CORRECT & COMPLETE
- Classification now runs against **stderr only** (never the path-bearing wrapped err), and the redundant bare `"Path"` clause is removed. Verified git wording on-box: absent@valid-rev → `path 'X' does not exist in 'HEAD'` (matches `does not exist`); disk-not-in-rev → `exists on disk, but not in 'HEAD'` (matches); bad-rev → `invalid object name` (no match → propagates). All three remaining substrings are correct and the bad-rev stderr does NOT echo the path, so the "Path"-in-path swallow is genuinely gone.
- All git invocations in the package now route through `newCmd` (the sole `exec.CommandContext` is inside it) — locale pin is applied package-wide, not partially.
- All 5 `ShowFile` callers reviewed: `analyze.go`/`dependents.go` now correctly propagate the real error (return err); `provider.go` (×2) collapse `err||!ok` identically, so no behavior change. No upstream code classifies absence by scanning `ShowFile`'s returned error string (confirmed), so re-embedding `path` in the new ShowFile error message is safe.
- `run()` refactor preserves identical error format/behavior for its other callers.

## CONFIRMED findings

`[med] git.go:462 — locale pin relies on non-portable duplicate-env last-wins semantics.` `newCmd` does `append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C", "LANG=C")`. If the parent env already has `LC_ALL` set, this yields a **duplicate** env entry. Empirically on this machine (darwin) the **last** duplicate wins → pin works. But glibc/Linux `getenv` returns the **first** match, so a pre-set non-C `LC_ALL` in the parent defeats the append and git emits localized stderr → genuinely-absent files stop matching `does not exist` and get reported as real errors (analyze/dependents fail). Scenario is narrow (needs `LC_ALL` explicitly pre-set to a translated locale on a glibc host; a bare `LANG=en_US.UTF-8` is harmless because an effective `LC_ALL=C` overrides it). CI runs ubuntu+macos+windows but with `LC_ALL` unset, so no duplicate is produced and checks pass — the defect is latent. Robust form would strip existing `LC_ALL`/`LANG`/`LC_MESSAGES`/`LANGUAGE` before appending. (Note: this is an *incomplete* hardening of a pre-existing locale fragility, not a regression the PR introduces — pre-fix there was no pin at all.)

`[med] git_test.go:281-300 — TestNewCmdPinsSubprocessLocaleToC gives false confidence; validates the Env slice, not git's effective locale.` The test iterates `cmd.Env` and captures the **last** `LC_ALL`/`LANG` value — which is "C" on every platform regardless of getenv duplicate-resolution semantics. It therefore passes even on a glibc host where git would actually resolve the *first* (translated) duplicate. It proves "the C entry was appended", not "git sees C". It does not exercise the very failure mode (duplicate-env override) that the pin exists to prevent. Mutation note: it *would* fail if the env-setting were removed entirely (cmd.Env→nil), so it guards regression of the feature's existence, just not its correctness under a pre-set LC_ALL.

## POSSIBLE / low / nits

`[low] git.go:294 — residual path-substring coupling remains (much reduced).` Classification still substring-matches git's stderr, and git echoes the path into its genuinely-absent message. A path literally containing `does not exist` / `exists on disk, but not in` / `not found` is still classified absent — harmless when it IS absent. A *real* (non-absent) `git show REV:PATH` error that echoes the full path could theoretically re-trigger a false-absent, but I could not construct one (bad-rev echoes only the rev, not the path). Vastly narrower than the original bug; noted, not confirmed exploitable.

`[nit] git.go:298 — "not found" clause appears dead for git show REV:PATH.` I could not produce any `git show REV:PATH` stderr containing `not found` (absent → `does not exist`; disk-vs-rev → `exists on disk, but not in`). Harmless; no non-absent `git show` error contains it either, so no false-positive risk observed.
